§3 L177's 48 px gutter floor cannot hold an 8-glyph BTCUSDT price ('64,012.0') in compact's axis type: type.num.sm is 52.8 px (E11-D02 §2 L89), and E11-D02 §2 L91 sizes the compact gutter as the widest label + 8, about 61 px. For the spec author: confirm, or keep opposed bars outline-free (then inset 1, its state line and the deviation change).

The delta and delta_total floors (§4.2 L263-264; memo §3.2: 6 glyphs per signed delta, '-8,192') leave out the '▲ ' / '▼ ' prefix §4.2 L254 and QA R2 (§1.3 L123) put before every delta: '▲ +1,206' needs 51 px against delta's 40; this board's deltas stay at 3 digits. For the spec author (E18-K01 measures).

Folded, a bracket lies in the cells' outer 2 px (D4 L154), so active (3 px) and tested (2 px) both draw 2 px and weight no longer separates them (§4.4 L288-289; §8.3 L761); the word (hover, focus, selection; SCR-056) carries the state. For the spec author and E18-K01.

D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no such word: the legend reads 'FP Delta · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (kit legend_text). Carry for E18-D05 (to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): a legend '· forming' while the newest or cursor bar forms.

rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-width-floors' to 'SCR-030/fp-width-floors' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-width-floors')
No inst nodes: every control, chip, the legend and the badge are compositions (kit DEVIATIONS compose), so there is no set, variant or text layer to verify.

Price labels: 20 in the frame and 8 in inset 2, each an 8-glyph price in type.num.xs at x 0 of the 48 px CMP-188 gutter (48 px estimated): check none enters the plot and none is cut at the frame's or the inset's right edge.

Pressed: [FP], Chart and auto lead with the 16 px check glyph in ink on the selected fill (3 per chart view, 6 in all); the third cluster segment is the chevron-right glyph, no '>' text. Cluster: frame x 2453.5, inset 2 x 1173.5, about 98.5 × 24 px, y 0 in the 24 px strip; the last time label ends 70 px before it in the frame ('13:20') and 76 px in inset 2 ('13:00'): check nothing overlaps.
Inset 1 layer order per bar column: wick, the cells bands (opposed bars), the 'outlines' band (four 1.5 px ink edges per flagged half), then the marks: check each bar shows inside its outline.
Folded brackets: 2 px wide, flush with the cells' right edge (buy) or left edge (sell); where a stacked level is also outlined, the outline's outer edge and the bracket meet at the cells' edge.
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candles: every column on this board is folded (D4 L154), so each bar draws its 1 px wick in the gap, top to bottom (every row traded, §3 L193), and no body; bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) stay in the scene and only break POC ties (`24` §4.5, the close).

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).

Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared, as §4.1 draws its column (L233 'three outlined cells'; the sketch outlines no edge). `24` §4.2 (L792) treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero volume under zero_policy treat_as_min, a fixed default (spec §6.2 L535-537): every bar here spans r1-r40, and all 120 of its 120 edge sides are non-zero (60 highs' bids, 60 lows' asks), so `24` would add 120 outlines to the frame (916, not 796) and 5 stacks (10:05 ×3 sell 64,011.0–64,013.9; 10:45 ×3 sell 64,011.0–64,013.9; 10:50 ×3 buy 63,974.0–63,976.9; 11:50 ×3 sell 64,011.0–64,013.9; 12:30 ×3 sell 64,011.0–64,013.9). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either an A-row to `24` §4.2 'edge levels are not compared' (what every board draws), or the boards draw the edge outlines.
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
A zero delta is drawn '0' with no ▲ / ▼ (§4.2 gives signed values only).
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' unless the board names another state: 3 px unfolded, 2 px in this board's folded columns (D4 L154).
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels (CMP-188): whole-price steps at E11-D02 §5's 40 px gap, every 2 rows in the frame and every 5 in inset 2 (kit price_gutter). 60 bars fill both plots (60 × 41.47 = 2,488 px; 60 × 20.13 = 1,208 px), so there is no free margin for the kit's overflow (DEVIATIONS['axis']): the labels use type.num.xs (E11-D02 §2 L89's dense axis type; compact's is type.num.sm) at x 0 inside §3's 48 px gutter (L177), 8 glyphs × 6.0 px = 48 px, without E11-D02 §2 L90's 4 px padding (copy gap).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
Folded columns narrower than the floor keep a 1.3 px candle gap (kit default; §3 L200 gives 1.3 px for the 60-bar case).

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 `check` glyph (size.icon, ink) before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the glyph stands for the sketch's '*', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1 L114, L139) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8 L115; §7.2 L267: the glyph is the ≥ 3:1 state carrier, L493-495); §8.3 L771 asks a geometry or text carrier for every state. The kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill alone, so gen_18 adds the glyph. Not drawn: E11-D02's color.border.strong reinforcement edge (not a wireframe grey) and E11-D04's option glyphs icon/chart-candles and icon/table (not registry glyphs, CR-D04-3; the words carry the options).

The cluster (CMP-189's [ auto | fit | › ], E11-D02 §7.2 L267): segments at least 24 × 24 (E11-D02 §2 L93, L652; the kit draws 20 px pills): auto 50.5 × 24, fit 24 × 24, Latest 24 × 24 px; the third is E11-D02's `›`, drawn as the CMP-019 chevron-right glyph and named 'Latest' (D8 L115; L267); §4.1's ASCII sketch writes '>' (L227). The wider cluster moves left and time labels keep E11-D02's 8 px exclusion zone to its left (L267): '13:30' is not drawn in the frame or in inset 2.

Folded brackets are 2 px wide over the cells' outer 2 px (D4 L154), not the zone weight (3 px active, §4.4 L289; kit WEIGHT): min(weight, 2 px), the buy bracket's right edge and the sell bracket's left edge on the cells' edges (15 in the frame, 3 in inset 1, 15 in inset 2, all active). A 2 px sell bracket still meets the text box of 15 three-digit sell-side deltas ('▼ -110' and the like start at x 2.5) by 0.8 px; E18-K01 checks the folded marks read (D4 L154).

Inset 1 (Bid × Ask, opposed bars): the outline covers the flagged side's half, buy on the ask half right of the centre, sell on the bid half left (§4.4 L284-285's one-number rule; L0 by height): 219 flagged halves in the crop (9 inside a stack), each four 1.5 px ink edges drawn after the cells so the bar stays visible (the kit's o / i pair would be covered by the bar or hide it). The spec states no outline rule for opposed bars (copy gap).
Box's 'bordered cell per level, heat fill by colorScale' (§4.3 L271) is not drawn at L0: the fill is hi-fi colour (E18-D03; §0 L28-29) and §4.1's sketch draws digits only (L220-224).

Forming carrier: with the cap outside the plot (kit clip) and no legend word (copy gap, D7 L157 vs §4.9 L380-382), the 13:35 bar reads as forming only through 'bar close 0:41' (§4.6 L314); boards 21 and 28 draw the cap (§0 L63, L70).

Inset 2: below the weak band (|Δ| < 5 BTC, §4.9 L384's colour key) a cell has no fill, so the 1 px notch has nothing to cut (§4.2 L260; §8.3 L758): 102 of 2,400 cells, 88 of them with a non-zero delta, show no sign; it stays in the tooltip, drawer and mirror.

Inset 1 is a 1:1 crop (30 of 60 bars × 22 of 40 rows) of the same 2560 × 1440 pane: a whole second 2560 × 1440 view does not fit the 4,600 × 1,700 slot beside the frame and inset 2 (the kit's board fit check). Its zoom badge sits at the pane's bottom-left, outside the crop (state block); inset 2 draws the same copy. gen_18's prune_below leaves out 1137 nodes wholly below the crop (no visible change).

Names: four kit nodes take the build notes' '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' form from `15`: CMP-188 PriceAxis (L2220), CMP-189 TimeAxis (L2233), CMP-223 DrawingToolbar (L2610) and the corner badge as CMP-180 ChartRoot's reduced-detail state (L2086, L2091); e18kit.py keeps 'CMP-188 price gutter', 'CMP-189 time strip', 'CMP-223 drawing rail' and 'corner badge' until the kit is renamed.
